Atomicity and flight-to-result ordering are not guaranteed, so inspect campaigns before retrying an uncertain request.

windowDays.description: Attribution window in days; units are provisional pending validation.

tags.instructions: Use this when you need a reporting file, not an immediate record lookup. Choose the report type and date range; use `get-campaign` for one campaign's current details, `get-advertiser-overview` for an immediate summary, or `list-advertiser-ads` for browsable ad rows. Keep the task ID to check file-processing status later; download the URL only once status is done. Show-level reports require show-level reporting access; audience-size reports require a publisher account. Recent YouTube results may change: use an end date at least three days ago when accuracy matters. This call only requests the report and does not wait for completion.

showExternalId.description: Replacement Apple Podcasts or YouTube show identifier.

expectedLandingUrl.description: Replacement expected landing URL; empty requests clearing.

expectedUnitGroups.description: Replacement grouped expected units, preserving the provider's nested grouping distinction; [] requests clearing.

length.description: Expected length in provider units; unit semantics require validation.

items.description: Expected placement and length.
One provider expected-unit group.

changes.description: Partial modifications. Omitted fields remain unchanged; arrays replace; empty clearable text or arrays clear. Null is rejected.

FunctionInput_podscribe_updatecampaign.description: Partially modify one active campaign by internal ID.

id.description: Internal campaign ID whose update was acknowledged; not a refreshed resource snapshot.

FunctionOutput_podscribe_updatecampaign.description: Acknowledged campaign identity, not a refreshed resource snapshot.

tags.instructions: Get an internal campaign ID from `create-campaign`, `batch-create-campaigns` or `get-campaign`; external IDs are not supported here. Omit fields to keep them unchanged. Supplied arrays replace existing arrays; [] requests clearing. Empty optional text requests clearing; null is not accepted. Use `archive-campaign` for lifecycle archival, not this tool. Changing to radio requires weekdaysTime; non-radio must not include it. Check campaign state after an uncertain write before retrying.

functions.name: upsert-advertiser
functions.description: Create an advertiser or return the existing advertiser matched by its name. Alternatively, resolve a show's Smart Promo advertiser using its Apple Podcasts identifier.

advertiserName.description: Name to create or match against an existing advertiser; mutually exclusive with applePodcastId.

applePodcastId.description: Opaque Apple Podcasts show identifier whose Smart Promo advertiser should be resolved; mutually exclusive with advertiserName.

FunctionInput_podscribe_upsertadvertiser.description: Resolve an advertiser using exactly one advertiser name or Apple Podcasts show identifier.

lookupName.description: Opaque advertiser lookup name to retain for subsequent advertiser operations.

FunctionOutput_podscribe_upsertadvertise.description: Resolved advertiser identity, without indicating whether the advertiser was newly created.

tags.instructions: Use this to obtain an advertiser lookup name before creating campaigns or requesting advertiser intelligence. Supply a name for an ordinary advertiser, or an Apple Podcasts show ID for a Smart Promo advertiser, never both. The Smart Promo option can also create or resolve the associated show. This does not edit an existing advertiser's details.
